# The VCU service tools: reading calibration parameters over KWP2000
# (sweeps, probes), the parameter tables (generated by tools/generate-vcu-tables.mts), the service
# gate, and the snapshots kept on the card. Transport-free; the firmware supplies the bus and files.
set(emcool_vcu_sources
  src/bodies.cpp
  src/catalog.cpp
  src/charge_acknowledge.cpp
  src/charge_ack_watch.cpp
  src/charge_auto.cpp
  src/charge_auto_curve.cpp
  src/charge_auto_http.cpp
  src/charge_command.cpp
  src/charge_current.cpp
  src/charge_soc_limit.cpp
  src/clear_dtcs.cpp
  src/codec.cpp
  src/kwp_client.cpp
  src/reading_stores.cpp
  src/readings.cpp
  src/runner.cpp
  src/service_actions.cpp
  src/service_api.cpp
  src/service_gate.cpp
  src/snapshot.cpp
  src/store.cpp
  src/table_gate.cpp
  src/tables.gen.cpp
  src/write_audit.cpp
  src/write_codec.cpp
  src/write_runner.cpp
  src/write_session.cpp
  src/write_targets.cpp
)

if(ESP_PLATFORM)
  idf_component_register(SRCS ${emcool_vcu_sources} INCLUDE_DIRS include
                         REQUIRES emcool_async emcool_ble_wire emcool_log emcool_obd emcool_text)
  # No FMA: a fused multiply-add changes the last bit of a*b+c and breaks bit-exact parity with
  # the TypeScript reference (the charge-auto least-squares slope is where it first bites).
  target_compile_options(${COMPONENT_LIB} PRIVATE -ffp-contract=off)
else()
  add_library(emcool_vcu STATIC ${emcool_vcu_sources})
  target_include_directories(emcool_vcu PUBLIC include)
  target_link_libraries(emcool_vcu PUBLIC emcool_async emcool_ble_wire emcool_log emcool_obd emcool_text)
  target_compile_options(emcool_vcu PRIVATE -ffp-contract=off)
endif()
